steps.name: live-token
steps.summary: POST /api/live-token (src/app/api/live-token/route.ts) + src/lib/agent/live.ts: liveTokenRequest {sessionId, locale}, geminiTokenIssuer (v1alpha authTokens.create, uses 1, liveConnectConstraints pin model, instructions with current cart, 9 tools, AUDIO, input/output transcription; no lockAdditionalFields so every field is locked; default voice), liveConfig, issueLiveToken (device token only; bumpSessionCounter liveTokenCount 2 demo / 6 phone, then CONFLICT unless before paying, then daily voiceSessions 200; RATE_LIMITED 'Voice is busy right now. Please type instead.'; Gemini 429 -> RATE_LIMITED, other -> UPSTREAM, logs status only). Returns {token, model, expiresAt, voiceSeconds 180|600}; newSessionExpireTime now+60s, expireTime now+voiceSeconds. Tests: live.test.ts, live-token/route.test.ts (fake issuer, no network). Manual check 10-13 on next dev with real gemini-3.8-live: token issued, live.connect with it, text turn -> toolCall addToCart {cheese_burger, set, drink zero_cola} after 2.6 s; a 2nd connect with the same token closed 1011 'Token has been used too many times' (no saved log). ARCHITECTURE Endpoints/Limits synced (I-078).

steps.name: live-client
steps.summary: Browser side of Gemini Live, no UI. Pure, tested: src/lib/voice/pcm.ts (downsampleTo16k box filter, int16ToBase64 LE, base64ToFloat32), turns.ts (initialTurns(seq)/turnEvents/turnsReducer: seq +1 on the first output of a response after inputTranscription; speech heard mid-response counts for the next response, so requestCheckout+confirmCheckout in one response share a seq), toolRunner.ts (runToolCalls sequential; commandId <liveSessionId>:<call.id>, source voice, utteranceSeq, cartVersion() only for confirmCheckout; errors -> toolResult). client/api.ts: sendCommand takes optional commandId; liveToken(). public/audio/pcm-recorder-worklet.js (40 ms frames). src/hooks/useLiveVoice.ts: opts as specified plus `status` (stops on paid/expired) and nullable sessionId/deviceToken; returns {state, start, stop, secondsLeft}. start() makes the AudioContext in the tap, navigator.locks 'kibo-live-<sessionId>' (ifAvailable), getUserMedia, worklet, POST /api/live-token, dynamic import @google/genai, live.connect (v1alpha, token pins config) with a new liveSessionId per connection. One AudioContext; 24 kHz buffers resampled by the browser, scheduled back to back; interrupted stops them. Half-duplex: no mic frames while AI audio plays and 300 ms after. voiceOutput false: no playback. Transcripts flushed per utterance/reply via onUserText/onAiText. Drop, goAway or 10 s without setupComplete -> reconnect (new token) with 'reconnecting'; after 2 failed attempts, or token RATE_LIMITED/UPSTREAM/other refusal, mic missing, other tab, or voice time up -> onFallback(ko/en reason from pt voiceBusy/voiceFailed/voiceNoMic/voiceOtherTab/voiceTimeUp). secondsLeft counts from the first token's voiceSeconds. Hook is not wired into AssistantPanel yet (step 2) and not run against real Gemini in a browser. I-079 logged: chat and voice keep separate utteranceSeq counters; share them in step 2.

steps.name: voice-ui
steps.summary: Voice in AssistantPanel (phone and /demo). New VoiceControls.tsx: mic pill >= 88px, KIBO blue when off, white with blue border when active, label names the state (Tap to talk / Connecting… / Listening… / Thinking… / Speaking… / Reconnecting…) plus 'Tap to stop'; kibo-listen pulse (globals.css) only while listening, still ring under reduced motion; 'AI voice' role=switch (voiceOutput); demo voice time left under 60 s. P1 mic hint (phoneScreen 'mic', once per browser via localStorage kibo.phone.micHintSeen, phone mode only, after Start or when scanned mid-order): Allow picture, [Turn on the microphone] starts voice in the tap, [Type instead] focuses the input. In-app browsers (src/lib/phone/inApp.ts, tested): phoneScreen 'inapp' and usePhoneSession({holdClaim}) hold the claim so [Copy link] copies a still-unused link; [Order here by typing] claims and leaves a banner (no copy button after the claim, the link would no longer connect); claim also waits while the UA is unknown during hydration (I-080). onFallback -> reason as the composer hint + input focus; onNoise (noiseStep in turns.ts: 2 heard responses in a row without a tool) -> 'Having trouble? Try typing or tapping a button.' Voice transcripts go into the chat (chatReducer 'voice' action). While Live is open, typed text, examples and choice taps go to Live via sendText/sendClientContent (decision: one conversation; verified 10-13 that gemini-3.8-live answers a sendClientContent text turn with addToCart in 1.4 s, manual probe, no saved log). One utteranceSeq counter shared by chat and voice (nextSeq / raiseSeq), I-079 fixed. aria-live cart announcement is 'off' while the AI voice speaks. QA: fake media flags in playwright.qa.config.ts; assistant.qa.spec adds P1-mic-hint, P2-mic-connecting and P3-listening (mocked /api/live-token + routeWebSocket setupComplete), P3-voice-fallback (429), P1-in-app and P2-in-app-banner; demo.qa.spec adds D2-voice-fallback; mic size/label/focus ring and pulse-under-reduced-motion asserted; kibo-listen is an H motion rule in checks.ts. All AC pass, qa:ui 0 H / 0 T on the new states. Not run with a real microphone and model in a browser (step 3).

steps.name: voice-e2e
steps.summary: I-072 fixed test-first: menuForModel keeps badge; buildInstructions limits item descriptions to menu-data words, 'popular/recommended' = best badge, other item questions -> 'kiosk does not have that information' (staff only when needed; halal/origin rule unchanged). scripts/grounding.ts (tested, vitest now includes scripts/**/*.test.ts): reply names, deny-list words, popularity only for best items, off-menu food; eval-agent.ts gets expectation kind reply {mentionsAny} and stores only pass/fail, matched words, item ids. 4 grounded-reply cases. Voice: scripts/make-voice-fixtures.ts (npm run fixtures:voice, gemini-3.8-flash-tts, 48 kHz WAV, 1 s lead / 2 s tail; a style prefix gets spoken, so the sentence alone) -> e2e/fixtures/hero-en, fries-en, hero-ko.wav (fries-en not used by a test yet). src/lib/voice/e2eMarks.ts (tested, only with ?e2e=1, window.__kiboVoiceTimings): gate opens after 1 s of silence and sends one utterance (the fake mic loops the file; earlier it opened at an inner pause and Live heard half a sentence), speechEnd = last voiced frame before the model's first output, firstAudio, firstTool; wired into useLiveVoice. e2e/voice.live.spec.ts: own Chromium per fixture (launch flags cannot change per describe), /demo?e2e=1 -> Start -> mic, asserts the hero cart from /api/command responses and the same lines on phone and kiosk, MutationObserver for the first k-ring; every run appended to evidence/voice-e2e.json (fixture, pass, a/b/tool ms, command types, model; no text, no token). Found I-081 (Live added one set and promised the other): two instruction lines, call addToCart for every line before speaking. Official: 3 runs of test:e2e:live, 6/6 voice (hero-en 3/3, hero-ko 3/3) + demo text @live 3/3; gemini-3.8-live; median (a) 2,070 ms (over 2 s, I-082 open), (b) 1,084 ms. Eval after all changes 32/32 (evals/results/2026-10-13T02-54). TESTING ledger and ISSUE (I-072 fixed, I-081, I-082) updated.

steps.name: qa
steps.summary: QA pass on P1, P3 mic states, PX, D2: 0 H on every scoped state; no product code changed. assistant.qa.spec.ts adds 'P3: noise hint, voice reconnecting, then text after the retries fail' (fake Live socket the test drops and talks through; P3-voice-noise/-reconnecting/-failed at 4 phone sizes) and 'PX: the session stream drops, and the same phone continues after a reload' (events route answers one snapshot then ends with retry 1 h; PX-reconnecting). Security spot checks on a dev server (script in /tmp, prints only statuses/booleans): live-token kiosk token 403, no token 401, demo 3rd token 429, paying 409, no API key in token responses or .next/static (307 files). Flow A by voice from evidence/voice-e2e.json (6/6, no src change since); not re-run live. ISSUE: I-083 (voice states missing from QA spec, fixed), I-084 (320x700 voice footer takes half the screen), I-085 (voice E2E covers only the first sentence; real phones unchecked), I-065 and I-077 notes updated. UI_QA coverage line updated. phases/4-voice/qa/REPORT.md: A-I all pass, real-phone walk pending.
